question: Are cold parser measurements stable across three fresh-process repetitions on the complete public corpus?
hypothesis: Three cold repetitions produce bounded campaign variance while preserving zero-diagnostic results for both adapters.
command: node scripts/benchmark.ts --files 48 --iterations 5 --warmups 1 --cold-repeats 3 --adapters typescript,java --experiment 002-stable-public-baseline --hypothesis 'Three cold repetitions quantify baseline variance for both adapters on all 48 public files.'
acceptance: Both adapters complete without harness failures.
Every public corpus file parses without lexer or parser diagnostics.
All 144 cold observations per adapter are retained.
Campaign mean, sample standard deviation, coefficient of variation, and deterministic percentile-bootstrap 95% confidence interval are reported.
limitations: Public synthetic corpus, not a production workload.
Three campaign totals provide only low-confidence uncertainty estimates.
In-process timers exclude Node/JVM/container startup and eager generated-module initialization.
